description: This Java source file defines the 'Report' class, representing report entities within the Fineract project. It includes fields for report attributes, methods for creating, updating, and validating reports, and manages report parameters.

classes.name: Report
classes.description: Entity class representing a report with attributes like name, type, category, SQL, and associated parameters. Includes methods for creation, update, validation, and parameter management.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a Report instance from JSON command input, initializing fields based on provided parameters.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates report attributes based on JSON command input, with validation and restrictions for core reports.

methods.name: findReportParameterById
methods.description: Finds a report parameter usage by its ID within the report.

methods.name: getReportParameterUsages
methods.description: Returns the set of report parameter usages associated with the report.

methods.name: isCoreReport
methods.description: Indicates whether the report is a core report.
